title: LOCKUPHQ DR Writer — Charge 6-1 Output Schema v1.1
description: Output schema for FDOC Charge 6-1 (Disobeying verbal or written order) DC6-112F Section II Statement of Facts narrative module.

status.description: RED = missing required facts, no narrative generated. YELLOW = all required facts present but one or more are weak or vague, marked draft generated. GREEN = all facts present and specific, clean certifiable draft generated.

red_blockers.description: List of missing required facts that block generation. Empty array if status is YELLOW or GREEN.

missing_fact.description: What required fact is missing or invalid.

follow_up_question.description: Plain-English question to present to the officer to obtain the missing fact.

yellow_warnings.description: List of weak or vague facts that require officer review. Empty array if status is RED (no generation) or GREEN (no issues).

warning.description: Description of the weak or vague fact.

affected_paragraph.description: Internal fact-category tag (1=opening/scene, 2=order/response, 3=operational impact, 4=ability to comply/force, 5=charge advisory, 6=confinement/OIC) — not an output paragraph index. The narrative is a single continuous paragraph; see docs/lockuphq_dr_writer_master_prompt_corrected.md.

suggested_clarification.description: One follow-up question to ask the officer.

example_stronger_answer.description: One example of a stronger, more specific answer.

cleaned_facts.description: Officer-provided facts after normalization (rank abbreviations, time format, name case, etc.). Null if status is RED.

incident_time.description: Normalized to HHMM hours format. Example: '1800 hours'.

incident_location.description: Exact specific location (e.g., 'cell E3107', 'the Wing 2 dayroom').

inmate_behavior_before_order.description: Observational language only. What the officer saw before any order was given.

exact_order.description: The command itself only. No first-person phrasing ('I told him to...').

inmate_quote.description: Exact words only. Null if inmate said nothing or quote is unavailable.

inmate_said_nothing.description: True if officer explicitly confirms inmate made no verbal response.

inmate_tone.description: How the inmate sounded. Null if inmate said nothing.

physical_behavior.description: Observable actions only. Visual and auditory separated.

operational_impact.description: Effect of conduct on area operations. Must reference dorm/wing/area, never cell number.

force_used.description: v1.1 split field. Was any force used during this incident?

force_explanation.description: Required when force_used is 'yes'. Must be null when force_used is 'no'.

uof_documentation_status.description: not_applicable when force_used is 'no'. completed only when officer explicitly confirms. not_confirmed when force was used but officer has not confirmed documentation.

narrative.description: Generated narrative — a single continuous paragraph (no \n\n, no section headers, no paragraph breaks). Null when status is RED. May contain inline [REVIEW — reason] flags when status is YELLOW.

flagged_sections.description: Boolean-style marker, not a paragraph index: [] if the narrative contains no [REVIEW] flags, [1] if it contains any. Empty array when status is GREEN or RED.

ai_disclosure.const: This narrative was formatted with AI assistance using LOCKUPHQ DR Writer v1.1, Charge 6-1. All factual content was provided by the reporting officer. The officer has reviewed and certified the accuracy of this report.

officer_review_checklist.description: Pre-certification checklist. Always appended after every generated narrative regardless of status.
